classification_semantics.strict_phase_contained: Whole measured invocation fits inside one original planned requested phase
classification_semantics.crossing_touching_phase: Invocation overlaps this phase but is not fully inside it; duplicate attribution across phases is intentional

limitations: The predeclared primary overall median error is descriptive; accepted=false and full_accuracy_qualified=false remain in force.
Original compute/copy source qualification failed in 178 cells; lag-source qualification is false. No acceptance gate was relaxed.
Evaluation category steady means one known requested state over the invocation. It does not prove settled hardware behavior or physical quiescence.
Fresh heldout requested phases are 37-181 ms, with no settling exclusion; profile calibration excludes the first 1000 ms of each longer phase.
State 11 has only 15/2/3 request-constant invocations per independent PID; three distinct PIDs do not remove this sample sparsity.

One invocation extends past the original planned schedule endpoint while the last request remains known under the 1000 ms post-schedule grace. Hence primary request-constant and strict planned-phase-contained counts differ.
Phase crossing-touch counts can duplicate one invocation across adjacent phases; they must not be summed as unique invocations.
Matching stamped-profile versus bare-heldout instrumentation neutrality has not been independently established.
Actual CPU/GPU available-service transfer is not identified. Exogenous controller requests are inputs, not measured instantaneous available-service functions.
Whole replay is predicted conditional on its observed start; this does not establish an end-to-end online scheduler or search-policy result.
Validation covers one small H128/I256/q16/history0 Dense single-layer workload on one CPU/GPU system, F32, CUDA graphs disabled.
Owned host/device allocation holds are zero in this cohort; memory transitions, other machines, model sizes, MoE, quantization and CUDA-graph execution are not validated here.
Verified before-GO/after-sampling affinity endpoints constrain eligible CPUs; continuous CPU residency and an IRQ-collision causal explanation are not proved.
Per-state raw CV is diagnostic evidence for that requested state; CV pooled across changing states is not used as an accuracy claim.
No hardware run, fitting, model selection, prediction recomputation, row deletion or reading of the 755 MB frozen body was performed for this export.
